item.title: The hidden mismatch: Evaluating coding agents on the work developers actually do
item.description: The results challenged our assumptions about agentic coding tasks, and we used these lessons to build a robust benchmark that preserves quality on real-world coding tasks in our intelligent gateway.

item.title: AI21 Partners with Gong, Deel and Alice to Post-Train Specialized Models on NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
item.description: Over the past three weeks, our team of Forward-Deployed Researchers (FDRs) post-trained NVIDIA’s Nemotron 3.5 Super VL in partnership with Gong, Deel, and Alice to deliver specialized models that surpass or match frontier quality on their defined use case – yet at a fraction of the cost.
